description: Programs currently OPEN for registration, most recently updated first — Junely’s honesty signal. Freshness is per row, not a blanket re-check: live_verified means Junely re-checked that program’s own page today for after-school listings; for camps it only reflects the status/dates captured at last extraction, not a same-day check. Rows without live_verified reflect their captured extraction date, which can be weeks old. Optional filters: region, category, age, vertical.
name: whats_open
title: What’s open right now
